# Ansoff Matrix

```placewise-diagram
{
 "type": "matrix",
 "title": "Ansoff Matrix",
 "source_page": 20,
 "xAxis": "Product",
 "yAxis": "Market",
 "cols": [
  "Existing",
  "New"
 ],
 "rows": [
  "Existing",
  "New"
 ],
 "cells": [
  [
   "Market Penetration",
   "Product Development"
  ],
  [
   "Market Development",
   "Diversification"
  ]
 ],
 "notes": [
  "Best suitable for Growth Strategy cases, also handy for Market Entry, Revenue Expansion"
 ]
}
```

Diagram summary: The Ansoff Matrix crosses existing and new products with existing and new markets, giving four growth options: Market Penetration, Product Development, Market Development and Diversification.

* Best suitable for Growth Strategy cases, also handy for Market Entry, Revenue Expansion
